provider: OpenBayes (openbayes.com) — Chinese GPU cloud with per-tier workspace storage

free_tier.stated: Free/entry tier attaches 50 GB of workspace storage; the upper tiers attach 200 GB. Additional storage is priced at 0.5 CNY/GB/month — i.e. storage is a metered dimension above the included amount, not a free pool.

egress.terms: Not separately metered; the storage line (0.5 CNY/GB/mo) is the paid dimension.

tooling: Web console + CLI (openbayes CLI) + Jupyter workspaces. Datasets are mounted into containers at a fixed path. No S3 API.
chaining: 50 GB per account on the entry tier; 200 GB on the higher tier which is a paid plan. 10 TiB would require 205 free accounts.
limits_note: 50 GB workspace on the entry tier, 200 GB on higher tiers, then 0.5 CNY/GB/mo. GPU SKUs 32 GB-640 GB VRAM. No per-file cap published.

identity_cost.detail: email + +86 phone (Chinese GPU cloud; prior rounds found real-name/phone gates on this class).

reliability_note: Data lives in a workspace tied to a compute product; over-quota is billed rather than refused, so it can silently cost money.

evidence.proved: read live: '50 GB 工作空间' on the entry tier and '200 GB 工作空间' on a higher tier; '额外存储空间：0.5 元/GB/月起'
